This name is believed to have been used as early as the 11th century in India, and its popularity continued through the medieval and modern periods. It is common among Hindus and Jains.

Another reference to the name Chinmayi comes from the 16th-century Indian epic, the Mahabharata, where Chinmayi is the name of a celestial musical instrument. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and music.
